svg.aria-label: Database first, then the music library: 1. Database: The lidarr-db Kustomization creates role and database lidarr on the shared postgres-18 Cluster. Both are retained if the app is removed. 2. Secret: ExternalSecret lidarr-secret holds the database settings, the API key and the postgres-init credentials, all from 1Password items lidarr and cloudnative-pg. 3. Import: init-dirs creates /data/nas-media/Music on the NAS. Lidarr reads downloads from the shared claim and imports finished albums into the library. 4. Keep: The 8Gi lidarr-config claim is backed up by kopiur. The data lives in PostgreSQL, which has its own barman backup.
